name: Round label disc on a flat halo
description: A 128px solid disc in the accent with a two-word label centred at 18px medium sentence case (on-accent ink, 4.5:1). Behind it stands a second, flat 176px disc in a pale tint of the accent as its halo: a filled shape with no ring line and no blur, the two concentric. Hover: the halo grows to 200px and the disc scales to 1.06 (320ms ease-out); on pointer devices the disc may drift up to 12px toward the cursor with a 200ms lag and settle back on leave. Place it at the lower right of the hero picture, 64px from its edges, or centred under a short line as the lone action; it never covers the headline. On a flat field with no picture the halo may be left out: the disc holds its word alone and its hover swaps the fill to the ink. Phone: disc 104px, halo 144px, 24px from the edges, no drift.
phone: Disc 104px, halo 144px, 24px from the corner; no drift.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged none, but the two thin concentric rings are outlines and the 12px caps word is a tiny label. Designed out: the rings become one flat filled halo disc, the word is 18px sentence case. A disc on a picture is a button, not a box on a photograph.

name: Quiet tonal icon disc
description: The secondary round control, built as a tonal disc: 56px across at 1440 (48px on a phone), filled with the surface tone (the ground mixed 8-10% toward the ink) and carrying one centred 18px glyph in the ink: an arrow, a play mark or a chevron. At rest it sits calm beside a solid control, as the "previous" next to a solid "next", or as the play mark on a flat colour field. Hover and focus flood the whole disc with the ink over 300ms ease-in-out while the glyph turns to the ground colour and an arrow slides 4px along its direction; press scales to 0.95. Use it on a flat ground or solid colour field; over a photograph take the solid disc instead. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = disc, ink = glyph at rest and disc on hover, accent unused. Phone: Same 48px disc; hover becomes the press flood (200ms); a prev/next pair sits 12px apart and both stay 48px.
phone: Same 48px disc; hover becomes the press flood (200ms); a prev/next pair sits 12px apart and both stay 48px.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern is a 1-2px ring with no fill; a ring is an outlined shape and a hairline stroke, so the ring is replaced by a surface-tone fill with no stroke. The flood-on-hover idea stays.

name: Disc row, siblings shrink
description: A row of three to five round controls on one baseline: each disc 48px across at 1440, 12px apart, filled with the surface tone and holding a centred 16px glyph in the ink (share, next, play or a link out). Hovering one (150-300ms ease-out) fills it with the ink while its glyph turns to the ground colour and the other discs shrink to 0.9, so the hovered one reads as the lone large control. Use it for a small set of related actions at the foot of a card, a film or a project. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = discs at rest, ink = hovered disc, accent unused. Phone: No hover: the row stays at 48px discs with 12px gaps, and a tap fills the pressed disc for 200ms without shrinking the others.
phone: No hover: the row stays at 48px discs with 12px gaps, and a tap fills the pressed disc for 200ms without shrinking the others.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Discs are filled with a tone, never ringed; glyphs are plain marks, not emoji.

name: Solid icon disc
description: A round, icon-only button: a solid disc 56px across at 1440 (48px on a phone, never under 44px so it can be tapped), filled with the ink on a light ground, or with the paper tone on a dark ground or over a photograph. One 20px glyph sits dead centre: an up-right arrow for "go", a plus for "open", two short bars for a menu, a play triangle for a film. No label; it carries an accessible name. Hover and focus swap the fill to the accent over 400ms ease-out while an arrow glyph turns 45 degrees (up-right becomes right); press scales to 0.94. On a calm page the hover may instead scale the disc to 1.1 over 150ms with no colour change (scale the disc, not the glyph). Pinned 16px in from the lower-right corner of a picture card (44px there, opaque, never see-through), it tells that the whole card opens, and on hover the picture under it scales 1.04 inside its clip. Use it where one small control has to be found at once: the corner menu trigger, the arrow that ends a card row, the play control on a film, the corner of a picture card. All discs on a page share one fill; the size follows the role (menu 56px, row arrow 44px). Colour roles: ground = the page, ink = the disc, glyph in the ground colour, accent = hover fill only. Phone: Stays a 48px disc with a 44px minimum tap area; a fixed corner trigger keeps 16px from both edges; hover becomes the press state (fill swap for 200ms).
phone: Stays a 48px disc with a 44px minimum tap area; a fixed corner trigger keeps 16px from both edges; hover becomes the press state (fill swap for 200ms).
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Glyphs are plain arrows, plus, bars or play marks, never an icon-topped card or a drawn illustration; a disc is a filled shape with no stroke and no shadow.

name: Bare two-bar menu glyph
description: A menu trigger that is only a glyph: two 2px bars 28px wide and 8px apart in ink on a 66px by 50px hit area, no box and no word, at the right of the bar. It is dealt only where the ground behind it is controlled (a flat colour or a toned picture region that holds 4.5:1); over a busy photograph give it a solid disc instead. Hover: the shorter lower bar extends to full width (200ms). Open: the bars cross into an X. Phone: identical, 56px by 56px hit area, the only item beside the wordmark.
phone: Identical, 56px by 56px hit area.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: a two-bar glyph is an icon, not a rule. The risk is contrast over a picture, so it needs a controlled ground or a solid disc under it.

name: Rounded square icon button
description: An icon-only button with soft corners: a 56px square at 1440 (48px on a phone), corners 12-16px (the page's card corner, or half of it), filled with the ink on a light ground, off-white on a dark one, or a neon accent on a dark one; one centred 20px glyph (menu, arrow, external link). No border. Hover and focus fill it with the accent over 250ms and nudge an arrow 3px; press scales to 0.96. It serves as the menu trigger in a corner, the open-in-place action in a card's top corner, or a row of two or three controls 8px apart. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = block, glyph = ground, accent = hover. Phone: Stays at 48px with a 44px minimum; corner triggers keep 16px margins; a card-corner button keeps 12px from the card's edges.
phone: Stays at 48px with a 44px minimum; corner triggers keep 16px margins; a card-corner button keeps 12px from the card's edges.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The optional 1-2px contrasting border of the pattern is dropped; filled shape, no stroke or shadow.

name: Sharp square icon button
description: An icon-only button with square corners: a 56px square at 1440 (48px on a phone), corners 0 to 2px, solid ink on a light ground, paper on a dark ground, or the accent when it is the page's one action. One 20px glyph is centred (a menu mark, an arrow, a plus). No label, no border; the name lives in an aria-label. Hover and focus swap the fill to the accent (or to the ink if it began as the accent) over 200ms linear while an arrow nudges 3px along its direction; press drops the fill one tone. It belongs to a page where every edge is square: the menu trigger fixed in a corner 24px from the edges, the arrow that advances a row of work, or a pair of controls butted together with a 2px gap on one baseline. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = block, glyph = ground, accent = hover. Phone: Stays square at 48px; a fixed corner trigger keeps 16px margins; butted pairs keep their 2px gap and become a 96px double control.
phone: Stays square at 48px; a fixed corner trigger keeps 16px margins; butted pairs keep their 2px gap and become a 96px double control.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The optional 1px light border of the pattern is dropped (no outline); glyphs are simple marks, not illustrations.

name: Pill email field with submit
description: The page's one sign-up field as a pill: 56px tall and 420px wide at 1440 (520px at the most), fully round, filled with the lightest tone on the page so it is the only bright surface in view, no border, 24px left padding, a 16px placeholder in the muted ink. The submit is either a 44px round arrow button inset 6px from the right end in the ink, or a solid pill of the accent holding one word at the right end (120px wide, 4px inset). There is no hover; focus lights a 2px inner ring in the accent. One 14px line 16px under it says what happens next. Set it on a flat ground or colour field, 32px under a sentence. Colour roles: ground = flat field, light tone = field, ink or accent = the submit. Phone: Field runs the column width at 56px tall, the submit stays inset in its end, the line below wraps.
phone: Field runs the column width at 56px tall, the submit stays inset in its end, the line below wraps.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No outline at rest (the ring appears on focus only); not placed over a photograph; the page keeps one email form.

name: Soft filled field with end icon
description: A single-line search or send field with soft corners: 8px radius, 56px tall and 420-560px wide at 1440, filled with a tone one step off the ground (lighter on a dark ground, a little darker than the page on a light one), no border, 16-18px text inset 20px, a muted placeholder, and at one end a 40px soft button (6px radius) holding a 20px search or send glyph, inset 8px. Hover lifts the fill one tone; focus lights a 2px inner ring in the accent over 150ms. Use it for the one search or message field a page needs, on a flat ground, under a sentence. Colour roles: ground = page, field tone = fill, ink = text, accent = focus ring and the end button fill. Phone: Field runs the full column at 56px tall with 16px text (never smaller, so the phone does not zoom on focus); the end button stays 40px.
phone: Field runs the full column at 56px tall with 16px text (never smaller, so the phone does not zoom on focus); the end button stays 40px.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 1px grey border is an outlined box, so the field is a filled tone with no border at rest and a 2px accent ring on focus only; this makes it the light, soft-cornered cousin of the dark soft field.

name: Dark soft field with a separate action
description: A text field 52px tall and 380px wide with 6px corners, filled with the ink on a light page (one step darker than the ground on a dark page), no border. Placeholder 16px regular in a muted ink (4.5:1 on the field), 20px left padding; typed text 16px in the ground colour. The submit is its own 52px accent block 8px to the right (140px wide, same corners, 16px medium label). Focus: the fill lifts one tone step lighter over 160ms and the caret turns the accent; no ring. Error: one 14px sentence under the field. Used once, for a waitlist or newsletter, never repeated down the page. Phone: field and action stack, both full width and 52px tall, 8px apart.
phone: Field and action stack at full width, 52px tall, 8px gap.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after one change: the 11px placeholder becomes 16px so it reads. Dark filled field, no border, no inner box.

name: Poster-type pill
description: A poster pill: fully round, 64px tall at 1440, 24-28px side padding, the label in a condensed display face in uppercase at 24-28px (tracking 0 to 0.01em, one to three words, never small). The fill is one saturated accent with near-black or paper letters, whichever the contrast needs. Hover (300ms) rolls the label up (a copy rises from below, clipped by the pill), grows the pill 5% and turns the fill near-black with the accent as the letters. Use it as the loud action on a poster-like page, over a flat colour field or beside giant type. Colour roles: ground = flat colour field or near-black, accent = pill fill, near-black = hover fill. Phone: Pill 56px tall with a 22px label, full column width when it closes the first screen; the roll stays on tap for 300ms, no growth.
phone: Pill 56px tall with a 22px label, full column width when it closes the first screen; the roll stays on tap for 300ms, no growth.
houseRuleCheck: Uppercase is allowed only because the label is display-size (24px or more), untracked and one to three words; the house ban is on tiny tracked labels. No outline, gradient or shadow.

name: Display-face pill, palette swap
description: A pill set in a decorative display face: 56px tall at 1440, 36-40px side padding, the label in caps at 21-24px (tracking 0, one to three words) in a characterful display face, filled with one palette colour with an ink of the second. Hover (250ms) swaps the whole button to a second palette pair: fill, letters and nothing else move, no growth, no roll. The two pairs are chosen from the page's own palette so the swap reads as a game of colours, for example the accent and near-black swapping places. Use it on a lively page where the type is the personality: the action is the one place the face is repeated. Colour roles: ground = page, pair A = accent fill and ink letters, pair B = ink fill and accent letters. Phone: Pill 52px tall, 20px label, 28px padding; hover becomes the pressed pair for 200ms.
phone: Pill 52px tall, 20px label, 28px padding; hover becomes the pressed pair for 200ms.
houseRuleCheck: Large caps allowed (21px or more, untracked, one to three words). The optional 1px ring of the pattern is dropped, so the swap is of fill and letters only; no gradient or shadow.

name: Pill that starts with a chip
description: A pill whose left end holds a chip: 56px tall at 1440, fully round, with a circle chip 44-48px across set 4px in from the left in the contrast tone (the accent on an ink pill, the ink on a paper pill), carrying a 20px glyph or a small thumbnail (a product, a person, a place), then the label at 17-18px weight 600 in sentence case, with 24px of extra padding at the right. Hover (300ms) turns the glyph 45 degrees, or scales the thumbnail 1.1 inside its circle, and steps the pill's fill one tone. Use it for an action that belongs to something: the chip carries the face of what the action is about. Second action: a plain text link in the ink at the same size. Colour roles: ground = page, ink or paper = pill, accent = chip. Phone: Pill 52px tall, chip 40px, label 16px; it grows to the column width when it closes a block; tap shows the press step.
phone: Pill 52px tall, chip 40px, label 16px; it grows to the column width when it closes a block; tap shows the press step.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The label is sentence case at 17px or more (the pattern allowed 12px caps; that end is dropped); a thumbnail must be a real photograph, not a drawn icon.

name: Pill with leading play glyph
description: A pill 44px tall, filled with the ground colour (or white) and ink letters, a 14px play glyph and then a 16px medium label, 20px side padding, a 10px gap between glyph and label. It sits over the hero picture or the video poster (never over type), usually under the headline, labelled Watch the film or a similar two-word line. Hover: the fill steps to a grey tone one level down over 160ms. Click opens the video in a full-screen layer. Second action: a plain text link in the ink at the same size. Phone: 48px tall, the same glyph and label, centred under the headline.
phone: 48px tall, centred under the headline.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: a filled pill with a glyph, sentence case. A control on a picture, not a box laid over a photograph.

name: Tinted menu pill, roll and grow
description: A pill 48px tall filled with a tint of the ground (one tone step darker, no border), holding a condensed display label in capitals at 20px with no tracking and, 12px to its right, an 18px two-bar glyph; 22px side padding. Hover: the tint deepens one more step, the label rolls up out of its mask and a second copy rolls in from below, and the whole pill grows 5% (400ms ease-out). Open: the glyph turns into an X and the label swaps to Close. It sits at the right of the bar. Phone: 44px tall, same pill, the grow dropped.
phone: 44px pill; no grow.
houseRuleCheck: The 2px 20%-black ring is an outline: replaced by a filled tint. The display caps are 20px with no tracking, so they are not tiny tracked labels.

name: Solid menu pill
description: A pill 44px tall filled with the ground colour (white on a dark picture, the ink on a light one), a 17px bold sentence-case label and 14px later a 24px two-bar glyph at the right, 20px side padding. It sits in the upper right of the page margins and stays fixed while the bar itself goes. Hover: the fill and the letters swap (ground to ink, ink to ground) over 200ms. Open: the glyph crosses into an X, the label becomes Close. Phone: identical, 44px with a 48px hit area; it is the only item beside the wordmark.
phone: Identical pill, 48px hit area; the only item beside the wordmark.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: filled pill, sentence case, a two-bar glyph as an icon.

name: Tonal pill that floods
description: A secondary pill that sits quietly beside the primary: fully round, 52px tall at 1440, label 16-17px in sentence case at weight 500, 24-28px side padding, an optional 18px glyph before the label. At rest it is filled with the surface tone (the ground mixed 6-10% toward the ink) with the ink for its letters and no stroke. Hover and focus flood the pill with the ink over 450ms ease-in-out while the letters and the glyph turn to the ground colour; press scales to 0.97. It appears as the second action next to a solid pill of the same height and corner, 12px apart, or alone on a field of the accent. Dealt as the page's button design, the primary is the same pill filled with the ink (letters in the ground colour) and this tonal pill is the second action. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = pill, ink = letters and hover fill, accent unused. Phone: Both pills go full width of the column, stacked 12px apart (solid first), each 52px tall; hover becomes press.
phone: Both pills go full width of the column, stacked 12px apart (solid first), each 52px tall; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 1-1.5px border would be an outline as the only shape, so the border is replaced by a surface-tone fill and the hover flood is kept; the label is sentence case, no tracked capitals.

name: Display-scale caps pill with arrow
description: A very wide black pill, 70px tall and 576px wide at 1440 (the ink fill), holding a 39px display label in capitals (no tracking, one to three words) at the left and a 29px arrow at the right end, 36px side padding. There is no ring or border. Hover: the pill inverts to a light fill with black ink over 300ms and the arrow slides 8px right. It is the one closing action of a bold page and takes 160px of space above and below. Second action: the label alone at 20px in the ink with the arrow, no pill. Phone: the pill runs the margin width, 60px tall, label 24px, the arrow 20px.
phone: Margin-wide pill, 60px tall, label 24px.
houseRuleCheck: The 1px light ring is dropped (no outlined box). The caps are 39px untracked display type, not tiny labels.

name: Pill with oversized label
description: A dark solid pill (the ink) 62px tall carrying one to two words at 35px in a display face, sentence case, so the type fills over half the pill's height; side padding only 25px, so the label nearly touches the curves. Hover: the fill moves to the accent and the ink to its on-accent pair over 200ms. It is a big, friendly pill for a closing or single-action moment, about 260-320px wide. Second action: the label alone at the same display size in the ink, no pill. Phone: 54px tall, label 28px, 20px side padding, may span the margin width.
phone: 54px tall, label 28px; may span the margin width.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: filled pill, sentence case, no icon or ring.

name: Plain solid pill
description: The stock primary pill, used where the page's character comes from elsewhere: fully round (radius half the height), 52px tall at 1440, label 16px at weight 500 in sentence case, 24-28px side padding, no icon. Fill is the ink or the accent with letters in the ground colour. Hover shifts the fill one tone darker (near-black on a dark fill) over 250ms; press scales to 0.97. Place it 32px under the sentence it closes and keep it alone: the second action is a text link, never a second pill of the same fill. Colour roles: ground = page, accent or ink = fill, ground colour = letters. Phone: Full column width at 52px tall when it ends a stacked block, otherwise its natural width; hover becomes press.
phone: Full column width at 52px tall when it ends a stacked block, otherwise its natural width; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. This is one of the three stock shapes the review found on every page, so it is marked basic: the deal should prefer a distinct button and keep this as the fallback.

name: Compact pill that shrinks on touch
description: A compact pill 40px tall (hit area padded to 44px) in a bright accent, a 15px medium sentence-case label in on-accent ink, 22px side padding. Hover and press: the whole pill scales down to 0.95 over 500ms with an out-expo ease (a slow, soft settle), the colour unchanged. Used for in-card or in-row actions where a big button would shout. Second action: the label alone in the ink at 15px. Phone: the same size, the shrink runs on press only.
phone: Same 40px pill with a 44px hit area; shrink on press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after one change: the 30px height and 12px label were too small, so they become 40px and 15px.

name: Solid pill that fades to a tint
description: A solid pill 44px tall in the ink, a 15px medium sentence-case label in ground-coloured letters, 24px side padding, and no border at all. Hover: the fill drains to a 10% tint of the ink (150ms) while the letters switch to the ink, so the button looks emptied but never shows a ring. Press: the tint holds. It pairs well as a primary beside a plain-word action. Phone: 48px, the drain runs on press.
phone: 48px; the drain runs on press.
houseRuleCheck: The hover ended in a faint 1px ring (an outline); here it ends in a flat tint. An earlier pass kept a same-colour 1px border, which would stand as an ink ring once the fill drained, so the border is gone.

name: Solid pill with arrow nudge
description: A solid pill that ends on a bare arrow: 52px tall at 1440, fully round, label 15-16px at weight 400-500 in sentence case, an 8px gap and a plain 14-16px arrow, 24-30px side padding. Fill is the ink (letters in paper) or paper (letters in the ink on a dark ground); the accent is not used. Hover (250ms) nudges the arrow 3px up and to the right, and the fill steps a tone. The restrained primary of a calm or luxury page. Second action: the label alone in the ink with the same arrow and nudge, without the pill. Colour roles: ground = page, ink or paper = fill, opposite = letters and arrow. Phone: Pill 48-52px tall at its natural width, full width at the end of a stacked block; the nudge runs on press.
phone: Pill 48-52px tall at its natural width, full width at the end of a stacked block; the nudge runs on press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Arrow is a plain glyph; fill is a flat tone; sentence case.

name: Tonal pill with arrow chip
description: A secondary pill with an arrow chip at its end: 52px tall at 1440, fully round, filled with the surface tone (the ground mixed 6-10% toward the ink), label at 15-16px weight 500 in sentence case with 24px left padding, and a filled arrow chip 32px across inset 10px from the right end (ink disc with a ground-coloured 14px arrow). Hover (200ms) floods the pill with the ink while the chip inverts to a ground-coloured disc with an ink arrow. It goes beside a solid primary, or ends a list of rows as the "see all" action. Dealt as the page's button design, the primary is the same pill filled with the ink with its chip in the accent, and this tonal pill is the second action. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = pill, ink = chip and hover fill. Phone: Full column width at 52px tall with the chip kept inset; hover becomes press.
phone: Full column width at 52px tall with the chip kept inset; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's faint 1px ring is an outline as the only shape, so the body is a surface-tone fill with no stroke; the flood and invert on hover stay.

name: Opaque pill with arrow chip
description: A light or yellow pill with an arrow chip at its end: 48px tall at 1440, fully round, label 15px at weight 500 in sentence case with 24px left padding, and a 32px round chip inset 8px from the right end holding a 14px arrow (the ink disc with a paper arrow, or the reverse). Hover (250ms) rolls the label (a copy rising from below) and turns the chip to the accent. Use it on a dark ground or a colour field as the action that closes a statement; 32px of space under the sentence above. Second action: the label alone in the pill's colour with the arrow, no pill. Colour roles: ground = dark or accent field, light or yellow = pill, ink = chip. Phone: Pill 48px tall with the chip kept inset, full width in a stacked block; the roll runs once on tap.
phone: Pill 48px tall with the chip kept inset, full width in a stacked block; the roll runs once on tap.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Opaque, filled, no stroke or shadow.

name: Pill with trailing dot, label roll
description: A near-white pill with a small dot after the label: 56px tall at 1440, fully round, label 17-18px at weight 500 in sentence case, 28px left padding, then a 6px dot in the accent 12px from the label and 24px from the right end. Hover (350ms) rolls the label vertically (a copy rises in from below inside a mask) and the dot grows to 8px. It is the refined action of a luxury or studio page over a dark or photographic ground; keep it alone and 40px under its line. Second action: the label alone in near-white with the same roll, no pill and no dot. Colour roles: ground = dark field or photograph, near-white = pill, ink = label, accent = dot. Phone: Pill 52px tall; the dot stays 6px; the roll runs once on tap.
phone: Pill 52px tall; the dot stays 6px; the roll runs once on tap.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The dot is a text-scale mark, not a drawn decoration; opaque pill, no stroke, no shadow.

name: Sharp tinted box, arrow, flood wipe
description: A sharp rectangle 52px tall and about 220px wide with 0 corners, filled with a step of tint on the ground (cream ink at 12% over a dark ground), a 16px medium sentence-case label at the left with a 16px arrow at the right, 20px side padding. Hover: the cream ink floods the box from the left in 600ms (clip-path wipe) and the letters and arrow turn the dark ground colour; the arrow travels 6px right. Best on dark grounds, one to three of them in a row 16px apart. Second action: the label alone in cream with the arrow, no box. Phone: full margin width at 52px tall, the wipe runs on press.
phone: Margin-wide, 52px tall; the wipe runs on press.
houseRuleCheck: The 1px cream border and the 12px tracked caps are replaced by a tinted fill and a 16px sentence-case label; the flood is the idea.

name: Large soft button, leading icon, snap
description: A button 58px tall and about 240px wide with 8px corners on a dark ground, filled with a tint of the ink (14%), a 20px regular rounded-sans label and a 22px icon before it, 24px side padding, 12px gap. Hover: the button snaps at once (0ms, deliberately stiff) to full contrast: the fill flips to the ink, the letters and icon to the ground colour. The snap is the idea, so give it no transition. The label is a task word (Download, Try it), never a feeling. Second action: the label alone in the ink at 18px, no box. Phone: 56px, margin width as a single action.
phone: 56px, margin width as a single action.
houseRuleCheck: The 1px 80%-white border is an outline: replaced by a tinted fill that flips to full contrast on hover.

name: Saturated rounded button, brighten
description: A friendly saturated button: 10px radius, 52px tall at 1440, up to 320px wide when it is the one action of a column, the label 16-17px at weight 700 in a rounded-terminal sans, in sentence case, centred. The fill is one saturated accent with near-black or paper letters. Hover brightens the fill 10% over 200ms; press scales to 0.98. It works as the full-width action of a form, a plan or a card. Second action: the same shape in the surface tone with ink letters. Colour roles: ground = page, accent = fill, near-black or paper = letters. Phone: Full column width at 52px tall; hover becomes press.
phone: Full column width at 52px tall; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 12-15px bold capitals tracked 0.05em are a tiny tracked label, so the label is sentence case at 16px or more; the rounded face and the brighten hover stay. A colour-only hover on a stock shape, so marked basic.

name: Chunky display caps block
description: A heavy, toy-like block: 10px radius, 68px tall at 1440, 20-28px side padding, the label in a bold display face in uppercase at 22-26px (tracking 0, one to three words), an optional leading plus at the same size, filled with one saturated colour with near-black or paper letters. No border. Hover (200ms) lifts the fill one tone brighter and turns a leading plus 90 degrees; press scales to 0.97. It is the loud action on a bold, game-like or food page. Colour roles: ground = page, accent = fill, near-black or paper = letters. Phone: Block 60px tall with a 20px label, full column width; hover becomes press.
phone: Block 60px tall with a 20px label, full column width; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: Display-size caps only (22px or more, untracked, one to three words). The pattern's same-colour 2px border is invisible and dropped; no outline variant, no shadow.

name: Cream squircle, inverts on hover
description: A cream (ground-toned) rounded rectangle 62px tall and about 240px wide with 24px corners (squircle proportion, between a pill and a soft rectangle), no border, a 17px medium sentence-case label in the ink, 32px side padding. Hover: it inverts over 300ms to a charcoal fill (80% ink) with cream letters, the corner radius holding. Dealt on a warm, editorial ground where a pill would feel too glossy. name: Bold caps text with arrow
description: An unboxed action set in bold capitals at display size: 18-22px at 1440 (16-18px on a phone) in the page's display face at weight 700, tracking 0 to -0.01em, one or two words, followed by an 8px gap and a 20-28px arrow glyph; ink on the ground, no fill, 8px padding for a 44px hit area. Hover (250ms) moves the arrow 6px right and turns label and arrow to the accent. Used as the closing link of a row of work or a list, right-aligned beside a section's heading, or stacked as two or three big links. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = label and arrow, accent = hover. Phone: Same at 16-18px; arrow moves on press only; stacked links keep a 44px pitch minimum.
phone: Same at 16-18px; arrow moves on press only; stacked links keep a 44px pitch minimum.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 12px tracked capitals are the house ban on tiny uppercase labels, so only the large end stays: 18px or more, untracked, one or two words. No underline rule, no box.

name: Text with a sliding dot
description: An unboxed action in 17px bold sentence case, a 44px tall hit area, with 20px of room kept free at its right. At rest it reads as plain words flush with the column. Hover: an 8px solid dot in the accent appears at the place where the word began and the word slides 20px right (150ms ease-out), so the dot seems to hand the word along. It is a quiet list or footer-style action, several of them stacked 8px apart, never a lone CTA. Phone: no hover; the dot shows by default beside the current item, hit area 48px.
phone: 48px hit area; the dot shows by default on the current item.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: bold sentence case, one filled dot as a state mark, no rule.

name: Text that gains a block
description: An unboxed action in 20px sentence case (body face, medium) with a small 14px arrow before it, 24px side padding in a 48px tall hit area. Hover: a block in the ink wipes in behind it from the left (240ms ease-out, sharp corners) and the letters and arrow turn the ground colour, so a line of text becomes a button. Suits a short list of destinations, 8px apart. Phone: 48px, the block fills on press.
phone: 48px; the block fills on press.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged mono-type and violet. Designed out: the monospace becomes the body face, and the violet hover ink becomes the ground colour on an ink block.

name: Giant word under a picture cutout
description: An unboxed action 178px tall: a picture cutout about 104px high (a product render or studio cutout on a transparent ground, not an icon) above a 56px display word in capitals with an extended width (no tracking), centred, 16px between. Hover: the cutout lifts 8px and tilts 4 degrees while the word's ink goes to the accent (240ms). It stands alone as a big action in a grid of two to four such actions with 80px between. Phone: cutout 72px, word 32px, two across at 163px each. Needs a clean render or cutout for each; without one do not deal it.
phone: Cutout 72px, word 32px, two across.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged none, but a big icon above a word is an icon-topped block: the icon is replaced by a rendered or photographed cutout, no box or fill under it, so it is not an icon card.

name: Text link with leading play glyph
description: An unboxed action led by a glyph: a 14-16px play triangle (or a bullet dot) then a 10px gap and the label at 16-18px in weight 500 in sentence case, the ink on the ground, 10px vertical padding for a 44px hit area. It opens a film or a process, not a page: for a "watch it" or "see how it works" line. At rest it is static; hover and focus (200ms) turn the label and the glyph to the accent and fade in a 1.5px underline under the label (text-decoration-color; never drawn in from one side). Place it beside the primary button on a first screen or under a heading. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = label and glyph, accent = hover. Phone: Same size under the sentence, left-aligned; hover becomes the pressed colour.
phone: Same size under the sentence, left-aligned; hover becomes the pressed colour.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 12px tracked monospace capitals (house bans: tiny tracked labels, no monospace) are replaced by a sans sentence-case label at 16px. The leading play or dot glyph is the idea and stays, so it is no longer banned. The play mark is a plain icon glyph, not a drawn shape. The hover underline fades in rather than drawing in.

name: Text link with vertical roll
description: An unboxed text action in 16px medium sentence case in the body face, a 44px hit area. Hover: the label rolls up out of a 20px mask while an identical copy rolls in from below (240ms ease-out), colour unchanged. Used for nav-like utilities and secondary actions where a colour change would be too plain. Phone: no hover; the roll plays once on press, 48px hit area.
phone: 48px hit area; the roll plays once on press.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged mono-type. Designed out: the 14px monospace caps become 16px sentence case in the body face. The roll is the idea and stays.

name: Plain word action
description: An unboxed text action of one to three words at 18px semibold sentence case, no glyph, no underline, no box. It sits 12px under the sentence it belongs to, or beside a filled button as that button's quiet sibling (24px gap). The hit area is 48px tall by the text width plus 16px of invisible padding each side. Because nothing else marks it as clickable it takes the accent as its ink (4.5:1 on its ground) or lives only where the context makes the click obvious. Hover: the ink moves from the accent to the page ink over 160ms. It is never the only action of a section. Phone: 18px stays, the hit area stays 48px, and it drops to its own line under the text it belongs to.
phone: 18px stays, 48px hit area; drops to its own line under the text it belongs to.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: sentence case, no rule, no icon. The accent ink must pass 4.5:1 or the ink stays dark and the colour shift moves to the hover.

name: Text with trailing arrow
description: An unboxed action: sentence-case text at 16-20px in weight 500, the ink on the ground, then a 14px arrow 8px after it, no underline at rest, 8px vertical padding for a 44px hit area. Hover (300ms) moves the arrow 4px right and fades in a 1.5px underline under the label (text-decoration-color from transparent to the ink, offset 0.2em; it never draws in from one side). It is the second action beside a button, the "read more" at the foot of a card, or the link at the end of a section's sentence. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = label and arrow, accent only if the page has no other link colour. Phone: Same size, left-aligned under its sentence; hover becomes an underline on press.
phone: Same size, left-aligned under its sentence; hover becomes an underline on press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The underline is a text decoration that fades in on hover (it drew in from the left before, which is a drawn line); never a hairline rule. Sentence case, not caps.

name: Underlined sentence link
description: A link that stays underlined: sentence-case text at 16-18px in weight 400 (light on a luxury page), the ink on the ground, underlined permanently with a text-decoration at 1.5px thickness and 5px offset in the same ink; no box, no fill, 8px vertical padding for a 44px hit area. Hover and focus (200ms) thicken the line to 2px and turn the label and the line to the accent. It is the quietest action: the second action next to a button, the link at the end of a paragraph, an email address set as the action. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = text and underline, accent = hover. Phone: Same type size; sits left-aligned under its sentence with 44px hit area; hover becomes the pressed colour.
phone: Same type size; sits left-aligned under its sentence with 44px hit area; hover becomes the pressed colour.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. An underline is a link's text decoration, not a hairline rule or divider; the tiny leading dot of the pattern is dropped, and the text is sentence case.

name: Menu word with two-bar glyph
description: A menu trigger with no box: the word Menu at 17px medium sentence case in ink, then 12px to its right a two-bar glyph 22px wide (two 2px bars 8px apart, square ends), on a 48px tall hit area with 12px side padding, at the right end of the bar. Hover: the bars close from 8px to 4px apart (180ms) while the word stays. Open: the bars cross into an X and the word swaps to Close with a 160ms crossfade. Over a picture the ink is chosen to read on that picture (ground-coloured over a dark one); if the picture cannot guarantee contrast, use a solid pill under the trigger instead. Phone: identical, and it is the only item beside the wordmark; hit area 48px.
phone: Identical: word and glyph at the right of the bar, 48px hit area; the only nav item beside the wordmark.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: sentence-case word, a 2px glyph (an icon, not a rule or an illustration); no counter or number.

name: Action tile in a flat fill
description: A large flat tile that is itself the action, one or two to a row: 360px wide by 420px tall at 1440 (a pair spans six columns each, with a 20px gap), corners 0-10px (the page corner), filled with the accent or the ink, never a wall of colours. The label sits top-left, 32px in from both edges, 32-36px at weight 600 in sentence case (two or three words); a 48px round arrow chip sits in the opposite corner, 24px from the edges, in the contrast tone. Hover (350ms) steps the fill one tone and turns the arrow 45 degrees; the whole tile is the link. Use it to send a visitor to two or three destinations (shop, book, enquire) at a section's end. Colour roles: ground = page, accent and ink = the two tiles, ground colour or paper = label. Phone: Tiles stack full width at 280px tall with 12px between, label 28px, chip 44px; tap shows the stepped fill.
phone: Tiles stack full width at 280px tall with 12px between, label 28px, chip 44px; tap shows the stepped fill.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern showed rows of differently coloured tiles; that is colour sprawl and a wall of tiles, so at most two tiles from the page's accent and ink. The tile is not a card on a photograph and holds no picture and no icon beyond the arrow chip.

name: Giant square play tile
description: A square tile 602px by 602px at 1440 (about 42% of the width), filled with the ink (a deep tone of the accent also works), corners 0 to 12px. At its lower left, 48px in from the edges, stand a 60px play glyph and, 24px after it on the same line, a 107px display label of one short word (Watch, Play), tight tracking; the upper part of the tile stays empty. The whole tile opens a video in a full-screen layer. Hover: the fill floods to the accent from the bottom in 400ms, the glyph scales 1.15 and the label's ink swaps to match. Place it beside a short heading and nothing else, with 160px of space around. Phone: a margin-wide square (358px at 390), label 64px, glyph 40px.
phone: Margin-wide square, label 64px, glyph 40px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: one filled tile with a glyph and one word. It sits on a flat ground, not a photograph, and is one box beside a heading, not a page of boxes. The play glyph moved from the tile's top corner onto the label's line, so it is no icon-topped card.

name: Giant-type bar
description: One block, about 690px wide and 150px tall at 1440 (half the content width), filled with the accent (or the ink on a light ground), corners 0 to 10px, holding a single label of one or two short words at the h1 step (about 100px, display face, tight tracking, one line) with 48px side padding. The whole block is the link. Hover: the fill floods to the other colour from the bottom in 400ms and the label swaps ink to match, a short label nudging 8px right. It closes a section, so it needs 160px of space above and below, and only a sentence of 20px or less near it. Phone: the block runs the margin width (358px at 390), height 120px, the label drops to 48px and may wrap to two lines.
phone: Margin-wide block 120px tall, label 48px on one or two lines.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: one label, no tracked caps, no outline or rule. A box on a flat ground, not on a photograph.

name: Play thumbnail, filled
description: A video thumbnail 240px by 135px at 1440 with 12px corners holding a still from the film, a filled 44px disc in the ground colour at its centre with a 16px play glyph in the ink, and a 15px sentence-case caption (the film title, one line) under it, 10px below. No border. Hover: the picture scales 1.06 inside its clip and the disc grows to 52px (240ms). Click opens the video in a layer. Place two or three in a row, 24px apart, as a short choice of films. Phone: Stacked at full margin width, 16px apart; no sideways-scrolling row.
phone: Stacked at full margin width, 16px apart; no sideways-scrolling row.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny-uppercase-labels. Designed out: the 8px caps caption becomes a 15px sentence-case line beneath; the 2px orange border is dropped and the play ring becomes a filled disc. The stills must be art-directed or footage, never archive photographs. The phone row that scrolled sideways with a peeking third was a drag rail; the thumbnails stack.

name: Stacked row bars with chevron
description: A stack of full-width rows, each 88px tall with 12px corners, in a flat tone one step off the ground (rows 8px apart, so the gap does the work a line would do), a 20px regular sentence-case label at the left (32px padding) and a 20px chevron at the right (32px in). Hover: the row's fill lightens one step over 300ms and the chevron moves 6px right. Used for a short list (three to five) of destinations or ways in. Phone: the same rows, 72px tall, full margin width.
phone: 72px rows, full margin width.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines. Designed out: the 1px lighter top rules become 8px gaps between separate filled rows, which are cards in a list (not boxes in boxes).

name: Platform download badge
description: A black badge 48px tall and about 160px wide at 1440 with 6px corners, using the platform's official badge artwork unmodified (the glyph at the left and the two-line label are part of that artwork, so it is placed as an image). Two badges sit side by side, 12px apart, under a short line or beside a phone-screen picture. Hover: lift 2px and the black deepens (160ms). Only dealt for a product with a real app listing; use the platform's own clear-space rules. Phone: both badges 44px tall side by side at 150px each, or the one that matches the device.
phone: Two badges at 150px by 44px side by side, or the one that matches the device.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: official artwork, no outline added by us. Only valid when a real listing exists; do not draw a lookalike.

name: Tall narrow side tab
description: A portrait tab 64px wide by 160px tall, sharp corners, filled with the ink, fixed at the right of the screen 24px in from the edge and centred vertically. Its label (one or two words, 16px medium sentence case, turned a quarter turn to read bottom to top) fills the upper part and a 24px arrow sits at the foot. Hover: the tab grows 8px wider toward the content (200ms) and the fill goes to the accent. It is a persistent but quiet door to the one action (Contact, Book). It never touches the screen edge, and it lives in the right margin: the content column keeps 16px clear of it, so no text runs under the tab. Phone: it becomes a pill 48px tall pinned 16px above the bottom edge and the safe area, right-aligned, label horizontal.
phone: A 48px pill pinned 16px above the bottom edge, label horizontal.
houseRuleCheck: It sits 24px in from the edge so nothing runs into a screen edge; a fixed tab is not a rail or a progress bar. The content column keeps 16px clear of the fixed tab, and its avoidWith names the bottom-dock and corners navigation designs (each already fixes the one action on screen).

name: Wide tile with leading picture
description: A tile 320px by 128px with 4px corners, filled with one flat colour, a picture block 72px square at the left (inset 16px, 8px corners; a product shot or a styled still) and an 18px bold sentence-case label beside it, 16px gap, vertically centred. Hover: the fill steps one tint lighter and the picture scales 1.08 inside its clip (240ms). Two or three such tiles in a row, 16px apart, each in one of the page's own tones (the accent, the surface tone or the ink; never a fourth colour), serve as a choice of paths (for you, for your team). Phone: stacked full margin width, 104px tall, the picture 64px.
phone: Stacked, full margin width, 104px tall, picture 64px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after one change: the 16px tracked caps become an 18px sentence-case label; the picture block must be a styled image, not an icon. A tile with a picture inside is one card, not a box in a box. a different colour per tile was colour sprawl; the tiles keep to the accent, the surface tone and the ink.
